key_water_bodies.name: Upper Lake (Bada Talab / Bhojtal)
key_water_bodies.note: Largest man-made lake in Asia at time of construction. Any sanitation or chemical discharge near this lake must be escalated to CRITICAL priority immediately.

key_water_bodies.name: Lower Lake (Chhota Talab)
key_water_bodies.note: Connects to Upper Lake. Waste dumping near this area auto-escalates to HIGH priority.

key_water_bodies.name: Shahpura Lake
key_water_bodies.note: Urban lake in residential zone. Encroachment and illegal dumping are primary concerns.

key_water_bodies.name: Kerwa Dam / Reservoir
key_water_bodies.note: Source of drinking water. Any pollution complaint near Kerwa must be treated as HIGH.

local_slang_dictionary.gadda: Pothole / road pit (PWD alternate term used in Bhopal)
local_slang_dictionary.pathar: Stone or rock obstruction on road (PWD)
local_slang_dictionary.gaay: Stray cow on road (BMC Animal Husbandry)
local_slang_dictionary.bhiya: Polite local greeting - ignore for classification
local_slang_dictionary.dekhna: Please look into this - marker of complaint intent
local_slang_dictionary.karo bhai: Please do something - marker of complaint intent
local_slang_dictionary.kab hoga: When will this be fixed - marker of frustration/repeat complaint
local_slang_dictionary.bahut din se: For many days - indicates chronic/ongoing issue
local_slang_dictionary.kaafi time se: Since a long time - chronic issue indicator

zones.zone_office_location: Sant Hirdaram Nagar Paani ki Tanki ke paas
zones.characteristics: Western entry point of Bhopal from Indore highway. Dense residential colony with moderate commercial activity. Sant Hirdaram Nagar is a planned colony.
Major entry point from Indore/Dewas highway (NH-47). Heavy commercial vehicle traffic. Bairagarh Cloth Market is a major wholesale hub. Halalpur Bus Stand handles inter-city buses.

zones.zone_office_location: DIG Bangla ke saamne, Berasia Road
zones.characteristics: Northern Bhopal along Berasia Road. Mix of dense old settlements and newer colonies. Khajuri Kalan and Chhola Mandir area. Road to Berasia town passes through here.
Historic Old City of Bhopal. Extremely dense urban fabric with narrow medieval lanes. Itwara, Budhwara, Kohefiza markets. Heavy pedestrian and two-wheeler traffic. Heritage sensitivity HIGH.

VIP zone. Proximity to Upper Lake (Bada Talab). Includes Shyamla Hills, Tulsi Nagar, Kamla Park. Heritage zone with tourism significance. Bhopal Gas Tragedy Memorial nearby. Raj Bhawan area. Extra sanitation sensitivity due to lake proximity.

zones.zone_office_location: Harshavardhan Shopping Complex, Mata Mandir ke paas
zones.characteristics: Premium residential south Bhopal. Shahpura Lake is a major landmark. Connected to Rani Kamlapati Railway Station (formerly Habibganj). High-income area with high civic expectations. E-5 sector and Char Imli area.

zones.zone_office_location: Yatayat Park, Purani Vidhan Sabha ke saamne
zones.characteristics: Central Bhopal. TT Nagar (Tatya Tope Nagar) is a major government residential colony. New Market is the most prominent shopping district. Idgah Hills, Sultania Road, Peer Gate area. High pedestrian and vehicle density.

Includes Pul Bogda, Hamidia Hospital area, Jahangirabad, Benazir, Nishatpura railway colony, and Habibganj (Rani Kamlapati) railway station area. Hamidia Hospital is the largest government hospital in Bhopal. Silence zone near hospital. Bhopal Junction Railway Station nearby.

zones.zone_office_location: Chandbad, Paani ki Tanki ke paas
zones.characteristics: Govindpura is Bhopal's primary industrial area (MP Industrial Development Corporation - MPIDCL zone). Heavy vehicle movement. Ashoka Garden is residential. Gandhi Nagar colony nearby. Industrial effluent complaints should be HIGH priority.

zones.zone_office_location: Shivaji Nagar Main Market, 6 Number Bus Stop
zones.characteristics: Upscale planned residential area. Arera Colony is Bhopal's most prestigious address. 6 Number (6 No.) Bus Stop is a key transit node. Bittan Market area. Connected to Rani Kamlapati Station. High civic expectations and awareness.

zones.zone_office_location: 12 Number Bus Stop, E-8/815 Paani ki Tanki ke paas
zones.characteristics: Central business hub. DB Mall, Board Office Square, Zone 11 area. MP Nagar is the premier commercial district. High-rise buildings, multiplexes, corporate offices. BRTS corridor runs through here. Jyoti Talkies intersection. Very high traffic density.

zones.zone_office_location: BHEL Zone 12, Carmel Convent School ke paas
zones.characteristics: BHEL (Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited) township and surrounding areas. Indrapuri colony. Chetak Bridge is a critical bottleneck on the approach road. Mandideep industrial area starts here. Dense population in BHEL colony with organized civic expectations.

Southern developing zone. Misrod, Ratibad, Sonagiri areas. Kolar Road axis. AIIMS Bhopal (All India Institute of Medical Sciences) is the flagship hospital here. Newer colonies with infrastructure still being developed. High growth area.

zones.zone_office_location: Bhanpur, Karond Dashera Maidan ke paas, Housing Board Police Chowki ke saamne
zones.characteristics: North-eastern periphery. Karond is a major intersection point on Raisen Road. Bhanpur Dumping Ground (Adampur Chhawni landfill) is located here - all garbage complaints near Bhanpur are high sensitivity. Phanda Road passes through. Airport Road connects to Raja Bhoj Airport.

Sanitation.priority_logic: CRITICAL if near Upper Lake (Bada Talab), Lower Lake, or any water body. CRITICAL if near Hamidia Hospital or AIIMS Bhopal (infection risk). HIGH if garbage uncollected for more than 24 hours. HIGH if open manhole on a busy road (safety risk). HIGH if near Bhanpur dumping ground overspill.

Traffic.priority_logic: CRITICAL if blocking BRTS corridor (MP Nagar to Misrod stretch). CRITICAL if blocking VIP Road or near Raj Bhawan during official movement. CRITICAL if accident with injury. HIGH if blocking DB Mall Square, Board Office Square, or any key intersection. HIGH if BRTS bus unable to pass. HIGH if blocking hospital access (Hamidia, AIIMS).

Public_Works.priority_logic: CRITICAL if road cave-in or bridge structural issue. CRITICAL if main water pipe burst causing road flooding. HIGH if pothole on Hoshangabad Road (Narmadapuram Road), Raisen Road, Berasia Road, or BRTS corridor. HIGH if near Chetak Bridge (major bottleneck). HIGH if pothole causing accidents.

Electricity.agency: MPMKVVCL (MP Madhya Kshetra Vidyut Vitaran Company Ltd)
Electricity.priority_logic: CRITICAL if live or sparking wires near residential areas, schools, or water bodies. CRITICAL if transformer fire or blast. HIGH if streetlights out on VIP Road or near Raj Bhawan. HIGH if power cut affecting hospital (Hamidia/AIIMS) backup. HIGH if power cut affecting water pumping station. MEDIUM if residential area streetlight out.

Water_Supply.priority_logic: CRITICAL if water contamination or dirty water supply (public health risk). HIGH if entire colony without water for more than 12 hours. HIGH if water tanker not reaching slum/JJ cluster. MEDIUM if low pressure issue in planned colony. LOW if single household complaint.

Parks_Environment.assigned_role: Zonal Parks Officer / MPPCB Regional Officer
Parks_Environment.priority_logic: CRITICAL if pollution near Upper Lake or any water body. HIGH if large tree fallen blocking road. HIGH if industrial smoke complaint from Govindpura. MEDIUM if park equipment broken. LOW if tree trimming request.

Animal_Control.priority_logic: CRITICAL if dog bite incident (requires immediate veterinary response and anti-rabies). CRITICAL if bull or large stray animal causing traffic accidents. HIGH if pack of aggressive stray dogs in residential area. HIGH if dead animal on main road. MEDIUM if stray animals near market or school.

Building_Planning.agency: BMC Building Permission / Town & Country Planning
Building_Planning.priority_logic: CRITICAL if building collapse or imminent collapse risk. HIGH if encroachment blocking emergency vehicle access. HIGH if illegal construction on road ROW. MEDIUM if hawker/vendor encroachment. LOW if general encroachment on park or public space.

landmarks.name: DB Mall
landmarks.priority_modifier: Any traffic complaint within 500m of DB Mall auto-escalates to HIGH due to extreme pedestrian and vehicle density.

landmarks.name: Board Office Square
landmarks.priority_modifier: Critical traffic node. Any blockage here affects 4 major arterial routes.

landmarks.name: Hamidia Hospital
landmarks.priority_modifier: CRITICAL for all complaints. This is the largest government hospital. Any road blockage, power failure, or sanitation issue here is auto-escalated to CRITICAL.

landmarks.name: AIIMS Bhopal
aliases: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bhopal
landmarks.priority_modifier: CRITICAL for all complaints near this location.

landmarks.name: Rani Kamlapati Station
landmarks.priority_modifier: HIGH for traffic and cleanliness. Major inter-city transit hub.

landmarks.name: Bhopal Junction Railway Station
landmarks.priority_modifier: HIGH for traffic and cleanliness. Main colonial-era railway station.

landmarks.name: VIP Road
landmarks.priority_modifier: HIGH for any complaint due to VIP security and tourism sensitivity. Speeding complaints near lakes are CRITICAL for safety.

landmarks.name: Bada Talab / Raja Bhoj Statue
landmarks.priority_modifier: Any sanitation, garbage, or pollution complaint mentioning this location is auto-CRITICAL.

landmarks.name: Chetak Bridge
landmarks.priority_modifier: HIGH for all traffic and road complaints. Only major link between MP Nagar and BHEL zones. Any blockage causes city-wide cascade.

landmarks.name: Shahpura Lake
landmarks.priority_modifier: HIGH for sanitation near this lake.

landmarks.name: Govindpura Industrial Area
landmarks.priority_modifier: HIGH for pollution and road damage complaints due to heavy vehicle movement.

landmarks.name: Raj Bhawan
landmarks.priority_modifier: CRITICAL for all complaints. Governor's residence - security sensitive.

landmarks.name: Bhopal Gas Tragedy Memorial
landmarks.priority_modifier: HIGH sensitivity for any pollution or environmental complaint near this site.

arterial_roads.name: Hoshangabad Road (Narmadapuram Road)
arterial_roads.route: Rani Kamlapati Station → AIIMS → Misrod → Hoshangabad
arterial_roads.note: Primary route to south MP. Any pothole here is HIGH priority.

arterial_roads.name: Raisen Road
arterial_roads.note: Primary east exit. Connects to Sanchi.

arterial_roads.name: BRTS Corridor
arterial_roads.route: Board Office → MP Nagar → Chetak Bridge → BHEL → Govindpura
arterial_roads.note: Dedicated bus lane. Any encroachment or blockage of BRTS lane is CRITICAL. Shared with high-frequency city buses.

arterial_roads.name: Ayodhya Bypass
arterial_roads.note: Key bypass road avoiding city center.

sensitive_zones.name: Upper Lake Buffer Zone
sensitive_zones.rule: Any complaint mentioning Upper Lake, Bada Talab, or Bhojtal → CRITICAL for Sanitation. CRITICAL for any chemical/industrial discharge.

sensitive_zones.name: Hamidia Hospital Silence Zone
sensitive_zones.rule: Noise complaints are HIGH priority. Road blockage is CRITICAL. Power failure is CRITICAL.

sensitive_zones.name: Raj Bhawan Security Perimeter
sensitive_zones.rule: All complaints CRITICAL. Alert security agencies.

sensitive_zones.name: Bhanpur Landfill Boundary
sensitive_zones.rule: Leachate or garbage overflow from landfill is CRITICAL. Escalate to NGT-monitored status.

flood_prone_areas.note: Ancient narrow drain network gets overwhelmed. Waterlogging in itwara, Budhwara, Kohefiza every monsoon.
Railway underpasses flood during heavy rain. CRITICAL if vehicles submerged.
Low-lying Pul Bogda area floods with continuous rain.

system_rules.zone_count_correction: This city has 14 zones (NOT 19). Any reference to 15-19 zones is incorrect. Always use zones 1-14 only.
system_rules.ward_number_resolution: If user mentions a ward number directly (e.g. 'Ward 50' or 'Ward no. 50'), look it up in the wards array and use its zone_id and centroid for location assignment.
system_rules.ward_name_resolution: If user mentions a ward name or area name (e.g. 'Arera Colony' or 'MP Nagar'), fuzzy-match it against ward_name, area, and aliases fields in the wards array.
system_rules.landmark_resolution: When a landmark from the landmarks array is mentioned, ALWAYS use its exact coordinates and zone_id. Do NOT use approximate coordinates.
system_rules.missing_location_protocol: Scan user text for ANY landmark, ward name, area name, or alias in this file. If found, automatically assign the matched coordinates and zone. If not found, return null for coordinates and 'Location Not Specified' for ward.
system_rules.proximity_awareness: If an incident occurs at a transit hub (Rani Kamlapati, Halalpur Bus Stand, Chetak Bridge), automatically flag connected zones as 'At Risk' for secondary traffic jams.
system_rules.lake_proximity_rule: Any complaint mentioning Upper Lake, Lower Lake, Shahpura Lake, or Kerwa Dam → auto-escalate department to Parks_Environment + Sanitation joint. Set priority to CRITICAL.
system_rules.brts_rule: Any complaint mentioning BRTS, Bus Rapid Transit, or occurring on BRTS corridor roads → flag as traffic_critical. Alert Traffic DCP.
system_rules.kolar_wards_note: Wards 71-85 are the Kolar wards merged into BMC in 2015. Zone assignment is Zone 13. Coordinates are approximate - use Kolar area centroid [23.185, 77.490] if no specific landmark found.

reject_if_true: Message contains only greetings from slang_dictionary with no issue described
Word count less than 4 and no image attached
Message is only a phone number or numeric string
Message contains only bhiya/bhai/ji with no grievance

chronic_issue_flag.action: Flag grievance as CHRONIC. Increase priority by one level. Note in classification that this may be a repeat/unresolved complaint.
